descriptionHtml:
Candidate N3 · proposed P1 · a new finding waiting for Quinn's confirmation, not counted yet

Hospital: leaving the chart after Generate, before the timeline refresh returns, erases today's Course Timeline entry; after Regenerate and leaving, the entry stays on the previous note

Tickets: TFA-92589 ready for qa (T2) · counts as a QA bug: to confirm · found on: local

Note: The scenario's literal steps pass; the failure is T2 (an entry for every completed note). Likely cause: useNoteGeneration.ts merges the refresh over getLatestPatient(), which stops updating once the chart closes.

Approach · TC-11 Course Timeline · S12 Double tap on Generate, and leaving the chart while the note and timeline are still being written

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T3 Re-completing a note (Regenerate) never creates a second entry. (TFA-92589 AC 3; TFA-92589 2026-10-02 comment)
  • T2 A new timeline entry is created automatically on every completed note, generated from that day's finished note. (TFA-92589 AC 2; TFA-92589 description 1)
  • U1 One entry per completed visit, correctly dated, in chronological order, never duplicated. (UAT TC-11; TFA-92589 AC 3)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Fixture Hospital patient {hospitalPatient} and resident {snfResident} with no course, plus a second Hospital patient {hospitalPatient2} and a second resident {snfResident2} whose names do not contain the first ones' (e.g. 'QA Second <tag>'). Run twice: variant a — both second charts have an empty course; …

When Hospital: double-click Generate Note & Finish on {hospitalPatient}; then press Regenerate Note and at once go back to the list and open {hospitalPatient2}; reopen {hospitalPatient}, then {hospitalPatient2} again. …

Then {hospitalPatient} has one card dated today. {snfResident} has its note and one 'Visit 1 – <today>' line, not 'Encounter done'. Neither second chart gains, loses or changes anything, on screen or in storage, before or after the first chart's refresh lands

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs, scoped to the course panels, plus the post-run storageCheck, which decides the wrong-patient question: the refresh writes seconds after Generate (EncounterTab.tsx refreshCourse; useNoteGeneration.ts getLatestPatient + savePatient), so the late snapshots and storage are what count. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S12 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-11.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16/17 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on dev; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-11 Course Timeline · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-11/S12

Double tap on Generate, and leaving the chart while the note and timeline are still being written

Tickets: TFA-92589 Course Timeline (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status failed in newspec-c/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

Detail:

PW on the local stack, variants a (second charts with an empty course) and b (second charts seeded with a dated line and a reason); generateNote held 3 s and refreshCourseAndBackground 9 s by the socket mock, so the late writes land while the second chart is open. Passed in both variants: the double tap sent one generateNote call and left H1 with one note and exactly one card dated today, no 'Encounter done'; Regenerate on H1 then straight to H2, and Generate on R1 then straight to R2: H2 and R2 never showed H1/R1's name or a line dated today, before or after the first chart's writes landed, and their stored reason and course stayed byte-equal to the seed and they gained no note, encounter text, carry-forward (Hospital) or status change (no wrong-patient write); R1 got its note and one 'Visit 1 – Oct 15' line, no 'Encounter done'. Failed (T2: the entry comes from the finished note): after Regenerate-and-leave, H1's timeline line is still the FIRST note's entry ('Less short of breath…'), while the note and tomorrow's carry-forward are the regenerated one ('Breathing easier…'); a control run that stays on the chart gets the regenerated entry. The Hospital twin of the Nursing Home step (Generate Note & Finish, then at once back to the list and into another patient) loses today's entry completely: the stored course goes '(none)' -> 'Oct 15: Encounter done' -> '' and the reopened chart shows no Course Timeline at all, although the note exists and the 'Carried forward' card shows the entry (reproduced 2/2; the Regenerate case 4/4 across runs). Nursing Home is not affected.

Product issue: Hospital: a physician who taps Generate Note & Finish (or Regenerate Note) and leaves the chart before the timeline refresh comes back (back to the list, next patient - a few seconds) gets a wrong Course Timeline: after a first Generate today's line is erased and the completed note has no timeline entry at all; after a Regenerate the line keeps the previous note's entry while the carry-forward shows the new one. Staying on the chart works. Likely cause (code read): useNoteGeneration.ts refreshCourse merges over getLatestPatient(), a ref in routes/rounding/Patient.tsx that stops updating once the chart unmounts, and its write guard courseUnchangedSince(sum.course, doneCourse) has only the post-flip value as a baseline, so the stale pre-Generate course counts as 'a newer human edit' and is written back (the Nursing Home tab also accepts its pre-Generate value: courseUnchangedSince(current, before, doneCourse)).

Evidence: 11 attached.

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: server-clock, variants, timed-wait. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
